criteria.requirement: Repair the PDeque bounded-sequence contract: normalize slices with slice.indices, match list values for empty/extreme/negative/full-length/reversed/zero-step cases, retain structural pop-based sharing for unit steps and original tuple fallback for other steps. maxlen=0 construction consumes input but stores no elements and both-end append/extend remain empty. Preserve capacity through slicing/reverse/remove/pickle-derived queues and leave the original immutable queue unchanged; retain existing negative-maxlen checks and positive truncation rules. Do not confuse pop negative-count opposite-end semantics with slice normalization.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
